tasks.short: Direct construction to design, budget and schedule

steps.what: Review current set drawings, budget position and construction schedule
inputs: existing production budget and construction schedule

steps.what: Direct and coordinate construction, erection and decoration against actual site progress and design, budget and schedule requirements
outputs: directed construction activities and resolved practical issues

tasks.design: Configure a native production reference view in {PROJECT} with links to current drawings in {DOCS}. It reduces reference navigation only; the designer still directs actual construction and resolves site issues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements and production constraints can require several views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views can bring existing references together.
tasks.still_hard: Recorded progress may differ from what is actually built.
tasks.human_edge: See a practical construction conflict and direct a workable response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project reference views can reduce navigation but do not replace directing physical set construction.

assumptions: Boundary is construction direction including reference review, not creating drawings, purchase orders or a progress report. The statement establishes no separate record write or send.

Drawing owner supplies current version; production management supplies existing budget and schedule with production ID and date. Missing updates require manual clarification in s2; no free progress capture is assumed.
Native views first. Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios; actual site direction stays fully retained. Gross 1.5 minus 0.3 upkeep gives 1.2 net.
unknowns: Current navigation burden and reliability of production references
research_questions: Does a native reference view save navigation without concealing stale schedule or budget information?

incremental.description: Maintain links to current production references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if references are already open together; up to 0.8% where gains are smaller than central 1.2% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate off-site set transport and on-site setup

steps.what: Consult the actual set dimensions, transport timing and site access arrangements
inputs: agreed transport timing and site access information

steps.what: Coordinate transport of the off-site-built sets with the transport crew and resolve loading and timing questions
inputs: transport crew's actual availability and concerns

steps.what: Coordinate setup at the site of use against actual delivery and site conditions

tasks.design: Use a native production reference view in {PROJECT} linked to the existing transport and site information in {DOCS}. The designer coordinates the real transport and setup through conversation and presence; the view neither books transport nor invents a loading plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transport and site details can require reference hunting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked references reduce navigation when the information already exists.
tasks.still_hard: Actual loading and access conditions can differ from the plan.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve a delivery or setup problem with the people doing the work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: shared production references can assist coordination but do not perform transport or on-site setup.

assumptions: Boundary is coordination with an existing transport crew and on-site setup, not supplier booking or creating a new transport manifest. No separate dispatch send or order is performed in this route.

Set design supplies dimensions; transport coordinator and site lead supply existing timing and access arrangements. Missing information is obtained in s2, not assumed structured or captured by another unpaid role.
Native views first. Shares and retrieval change are provisional scenarios; transport crew labour and physical setup are not claimed as designer savings.
Gross 1 minus 0.2 upkeep leaves 0.8 net. Resolve common production-reference upkeep with construction direction at roll-up.
unknowns: Whether a formal transport booking is performed by this role locally
research_questions: Observe whether coordination includes a separate booking or manifest write and measure it if present.

already_counted.description: Check actual transport and site references

incremental.description: Maintain current transport and site reference links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if references are already available; up to 0.5% where lookup gains are smaller than central 0.8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Agree protective exhibit conditions with conservators

steps.what: Confer with conservators to determine handling of lighting, temperature and humidity so objects are protected and the exhibit is enhanced
inputs: actual exhibit objects and proposed display context
outputs: agreed environmental approach and unresolved conservation questions

tasks.design: Keep the conservation discussion and environmental decisions with the designer and conservators. Reference material in {DOCS} can support other work, but does not replace object-specific conservation advice or establish a separate report-writing workload here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protective conditions depend on the particular objects and display context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference tools do not remove the need for specialist discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Reconcile an intended display effect with object protection.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the conservator about the actual object's constraints and respect uncertainty.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: protective exhibit conditions require object-specific conservation expertise.

assumptions: Boundary is the specified conference and environmental determination. It does not establish a separate conservation report, record update or controller-setting action; none is invented.
Inputs are conservators' actual advice and exhibit context, not an assumed structured condition table. Native reference access does not remove this discussion.
No software change or new recording means no upkeep; the whole task stays retained.
unknowns: Whether local conferences also require an authored environmental specification
research_questions: Observe any actual specification writing separately from the conservation discussion.

incremental.description: No introduced system or documentation process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Object-specific conservation discussion is fully retained; no separately authored specification is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and purchase set lumber and hardware

steps.what: Select lumber and hardware specifications and quantities suitable for the actual set construction
Check stock and supplier catalogue descriptions, units, prices and availability
outputs: selected supplier items, units and quantities

steps.what: Prepare the supplier purchase order with selected lumber and hardware lines and delivery details
inputs: selected supplier items, units and quantities
outputs: complete purchase-order draft with supplier destination

steps.what: Check the completed order's material specifications, units, quantities, price, delivery and authorized spend before purchase
inputs: complete purchase-order draft with supplier destination
outputs: checked final purchase order and supplier destination

steps.what: Send the checked final lumber and hardware purchase order to the selected supplier
inputs: checked final purchase order and supplier destination

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue-linked order lines and production delivery defaults in {PROCUREMENT}; the drawing editor {OTHER} remains the source for material requirements. The designer chooses the materials, checks the complete order against authorized spend and sends the exact checked version to the supplier.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order entry repeats item descriptions and delivery details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native purchase-order forms can reuse existing catalogue and production fields.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong dimensions, grades or units can make the order unsuitable despite matching catalogue IDs.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the right materials for the actual construction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement systems can reuse catalogue order lines while human buyers retain material and purchase decisions.

assumptions: OTHER is the drawing editor. Boundary covers material selection and purchase through supplier order issuance; delivery receipt and physical construction are separate.

Supplier or purchasing owner supplies catalogue ID, description, unit and price; production supplies delivery address and authorized budget. Designer supplies selected quantities in s1-s2. Missing data is manually entered and checked within s3-s4.

Assume the designer already has purchase authority within the existing budget; an unauthorized order stops rather than bypassing purchasing. Final order checking is ordinary purchasing work after the complete draft exists.
Native forms first. Shares are unmeasured scenarios; the 1% short send stays fully retained. Gross 9 minus 0.5 upkeep leaves 8.5 net. Any order or destination change requires another final check.
unknowns: Actual purchasing authority and current catalogue support
research_questions: Can native catalogue reuse reduce entry effort without errors in lumber grades, dimensions or units?

already_counted.description: Review order entry and verify the final purchase

incremental.description: Maintain production order defaults and flag catalogue errors

approvals.approved_version: checked final order and supplier destination from s4; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native order reuse is already configured; up to 6% where exceptions reduce the central 8.5% net scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Production direction and conservation judgement stay with people; native reference and purchasing functions reduce repeated navigation and entry.
role.ambitious_version: Practical set coordination with explicit purchase control and retained specialist conservation advice.
